approved: Education Legislation Amendment (Integrity and Other Measures) Bill 2025
Presented the Education Legislation Amendment (Integrity and Other Measures) Bill 2025 and its explanatory memorandum; the bill was read a first time.

Argued that the Education Legislation Amendment (Integrity and Other Measures) Bill 2025 would address international education, Indigenous medical places, offshore higher-education regulation and childcare information powers, while seeking a Senate inquiry into the childcare provisions.

Presented the seventh report of the Selection of Bills Committee and moved its adoption; amendments proposed referrals of specified bills, including environment, payday superannuation, terrorism, Defence and Fair Work legislation, to Senate committees for inquiry and report by dates ranging from 19 November 2025 to 24 March 2026.
